new_results.statement: For a planar probability density cap L, sup_c E|W-c|^{-1} <= 2 sqrt(pi L).

For a rank-two physical cross block M whose deletion of one hub row has rank at most one, if the opposite original-coordinate bank is quadratically clean, then ||p_Q||_infinity <= 2^(3/4)sqrt(pi) E_2(M)^(-1/4), with arbitrary self-curvature on the hub-side bank and arbitrary outside-conditioned affine terms on the clean bank.
For M=[[m00,lambda b^T],[mu a,a b^T]], E_2(M)=(m00-lambda mu)^2||a||^2||b||^2.
Combining B04 r26 with account01/B01 gives H_{1/2}(R) <= E_2^(-1/8) min(26.3340461808,13.0190353138 delta_3^(-1/24)) when delta_3>0, and the unconditional first term at delta_3=0.

next_step: From s_3(A)>=1, route remaining structural survivors to either a row/column star with a quadratically clean bank, a nonzero physical square with dimension-free |a|^4 E_2 control in the Schur residual, or an already-paid grouped/ridge/hub endpoint, without selecting a vanishing local coefficient or minor.
